summary: Added Console.out to rich/console.py: a low-level output method that joins str() of each object and calls print with markup, emoji, wrapping and cropping disabled, keeping only the optional style and highlighting. Added three tests in tests/test_console.py and a CHANGELOG.md entry under 9.0.0 Added. Nothing was run or committed, so the tests are unverified. I read "simple styling only" as style plus highlighting.
